prompt: Extract structured knowledge from this vacation planning source file. The file is at inbox/vacation-master-plan-v2.md. This captures implementation plans for information theory analysis, probing experiments, and LMT integration for USV research. Read the source fully, check for duplicates against existing notes in notes/, and produce an extraction report listing all claims, implementation ideas, tensions, enrichments, and skipped items with rationale. Do NOT create any files — just produce the extraction report. Save the full extraction report to the outputs directory specified.
assertions: Report contains a SUMMARY section with numerical counts by category
Total extractions (claims + implementation ideas + tensions + enrichments + validations) >= 8
Skip rate is below 15% (skipped items / total candidates)
Every extracted item includes a rationale explaining why it was extracted
Extracted titles are phrased as claims/propositions, not topic labels
At least 3 distinct categories are represented (e.g. core claims, implementation ideas, tensions)
Report mentions checking existing notes for duplicates or overlap
Implementation ideas are explicitly categorized (not lumped with core claims)
